# TR Sustainability

## Distintivo S

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
## read the pdfs in
dist_S_2015_raw <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/distintivo_S/tabulated_distintivo_S", "tabula-Directorio_Nacional_de_Empresas_DISTINTIVO_S_JUN_2015_VF.csv"), skip = 1)

dist_S_2017_raw <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/distintivo_S/tabulated_distintivo_S", "tabula-EMPRESAS_DISTINTIVO_S_JULIO_2017.csv"), skip = 1)

dist_S_2023_raw <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/distintivo_S/tabulated_distintivo_S", "tabula-Directorio_de_empresas_vigentes_Distintivo_S.csv"))
```

### Clean and join

```{r}
## 2015
dist_S_2015 <- dist_S_2015_raw %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

colnames(dist_S_2015) 
# [1] "no"                             "nombre_comercial_de_la_empresa" "estado"                        
# [4] "municipio_localidad"            "sitio_web" 

## 2017
dist_S_2017 <- dist_S_2017_raw %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

colnames(dist_S_2017) 
# [1] "no"                             "nombre_comercial_de_la_empresa" "estado"                        
# [4] "localidad"

## 2023
dist_S_2023 <- dist_S_2023_raw %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

colnames(dist_S_2023) 
# [1] "no"                   "folio_del_distintivo" "nombre_comercial"     "ciudad"               "estado" 
```

Okay, it appears that the "no" column is not very helpful, because the hotels do not maintain their number over time. 

The distinctive folio number is only available in 2023. 

Let's prep them for join.

```{r}
## 2015
dist_S_2015_join <- dist_S_2015 %>% 
  rename(nombre_comercial = nombre_comercial_de_la_empresa,
         localidad = municipio_localidad) %>% 
  mutate(year_documented = "2015") %>% 
  select(-no)

## 2017
dist_S_2017_join <- dist_S_2017 %>% 
  rename(nombre_comercial = nombre_comercial_de_la_empresa) %>% 
  mutate(year_documented = "2017") %>% 
  select(-no)

## 2023
dist_S_2023_join <- dist_S_2023 %>% 
  rename(localidad = ciudad) %>% 
  mutate(year_documented = "2023") %>% 
  select(-no)

```

```{r}
## join them
dist_S_all <- bind_rows(dist_S_2015_join,
                        dist_S_2017_join,
                        dist_S_2023_join)
```

### Geocode the hotels

```{r}
dist_S_goc_estados <- dist_S_all %>% 
  filter(estado %in% c("Nayarit","Jalisco","Sonora","Baja California Sur","Baja  Calfornia Sur", "Baja California  Sur","Baja  California Sur","Sinaloa")) %>%  ## note: no baja california.
  mutate(country = "Mexico")

dist_S_goc_estados_geocode <- dist_S_goc_estados %>% 
  tidygeocoder::geocode(city = localidad, country = country, state = estado) # to give each city a lat, long
```

Fix all lat/longs that tidygeocoder was not able to do.

```{r}
na_dist_S_goc_estados_geocode <- dist_S_goc_estados_geocode %>% 
  filter(is.na(lat))

unique(na_dist_S_goc_estados_geocode$nombre_comercial)

# [1] "Palladium Vallarta" 20.7153, -105.2464    
# [2] "Campo de Golf Litibú" https://www.rivieranayarit.com/activity/golf/litibu/  20.797847, -105.483116       
# [3] "Hotel Sheraton Hacienda del Mar Resort & SPA" 22.914233, -109.837037 
# [4] "Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit" 20.707216, -105.301422                 
# [5] "IBEROSTAR SELECTION PLAYA MITA" 20.790676, -105.489015
# [6] Gran Paladium Costa Mujeres Resort Nayarit 20.753902, -105.455937

dist_S_goc_estados_geocode_fixed <- dist_S_goc_estados_geocode %>% 
  mutate(
    lat = case_when(
      is.na(lat) & nombre_comercial == "Palladium Vallarta" ~ 20.7153,
      is.na(lat) & nombre_comercial == "Campo de Golf Litibú" ~ 20.797847,
      is.na(lat) & nombre_comercial == "Hotel Sheraton Hacienda del Mar Resort & SPA" ~ 22.914233,
      is.na(lat) & nombre_comercial == "Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit" ~ 20.707216,
      is.na(lat) & nombre_comercial == "IBEROSTAR SELECTION PLAYA MITA" ~ 20.790676,
      is.na(lat) & nombre_comercial == "Gran Paladium Costa Mujeres Resort" ~ 20.790676,
      TRUE ~ lat
    ),
    long = case_when(
      is.na(long) & nombre_comercial == "Palladium Vallarta" ~ -105.2464,
      is.na(long) & nombre_comercial == "Campo de Golf Litibú" ~ -105.483116,
      is.na(long) & nombre_comercial == "Hotel Sheraton Hacienda del Mar Resort & SPA" ~ -109.837037,
      is.na(long) & nombre_comercial == "Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit" ~ -105.301422,
      is.na(long) & nombre_comercial == "IBEROSTAR SELECTION PLAYA MITA" ~ -105.489015,
      is.na(long) & nombre_comercial == "Gran Paladium Costa Mujeres Resort" ~ -105.455937,
      TRUE ~ long
    )
  )
```


```{r}
dist_S_geocode_sf <- dist_S_goc_estados_geocode_fixed %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"),
           crs = 4326, # WGS84
           remove = FALSE)

mapview(dist_S_geocode_sf, zcol = "year_documented")

```


### Number of certifications over time

```{r}
dist_S_presence <- dist_S_geocode_sf %>% 
  distinct(nombre_comercial, year_documented) %>% 
  mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = year_documented,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0
  )

heat_df <- dist_S_presence %>% 
  arrange(nombre_comercial) %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`2015`,`2017`,`2023`),
               names_to = "year",
               values_to = "present")

plot_ly(
  heat_df,
  x = ~year,
  y = ~nombre_comercial,
  z = ~present,
  type = "heatmap",
  colorscale = "Blues"
) %>% 
  layout(title = "Presence of Distintivo S Certification Over Time",
         xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Business"))
```

#### Standardize hotel names

```{r}
library(stringi)

dist_S_all_clean <- dist_S_geocode_sf %>% 
  mutate(
    nombre_comercial_clean = nombre_comercial %>% 
      str_to_lower() %>% 
      str_squish() %>% 
      stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") %>% # remove accents
      str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9 ]", "") %>% # remove punctuation
      str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") # normalize spaces
  )

dist_S_all_clean_2 <- dist_S_all_clean %>% 
  mutate(
    nombre_comercial_clean = nombre_comercial_clean %>% 
      str_replace_all("\\b(hotel|resort|spa|suites|suite|all inclusive|the|grupo)\\b", "") %>% 
      str_squish()
  ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(nombre_comercial_clean)) %>% 
  group_by(nombre_comercial_clean) %>% 
  fill(folio_del_distintivo, .direction = "up") %>% 
  fill(sitio_web, .direction = "down") ## note that pueblo bonito mazatlan and emerald bay are two separate resorts.
```


#### Classify OHI Rgn ID

"https://www.gob.mx/presidencia/prensa/el-objetivo-para-turismo-en-el-plan-mexico-es-ser-el-5to-pais-mas-visitado-del-mundo-para-el-2030-presidenta-claudia-sheinbaum?idiom=es"

To achieve the goal of being the fifth most visited country in the world by 2030, it is estimated that it is necessary to increase the number of tourists by three million each year, as well as increase:
 

The economic impact of international tourists by 46 percent.
Hotel rooms by 12 percent.
The generation of tourism jobs by 27 percent.
The tourism Gross Domestic Product (GDP) by 9 percent.
Domestic tourism by 9.8 percent.
*The number of service providers certified in sustainability by 31.5 percent.*
The average expenditure per international tourist by 3.3 percent.
The arrival of international visitors by 30 percent
The increase in DNR revenue by 40.5 percent.

```{r}
library(sf)
library(mapview)

## first, join with OHI GoC Regions

inland_50 <- st_read(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/inland_50km_buffer","inland_50km_goc.shp"))
dist_S_all_clean_2_trans <- st_transform(dist_S_all_clean_2, st_crs(inland_50))
dist_S_goc_rgn <- st_intersection(dist_S_all_clean_2_trans, inland_50)

mapview(dist_S_goc_rgn, zcol = "rgn_id") + mapview(inland_50, zcol = "rgn_id")

st_write(dist_S_goc_rgn, here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/sust_int","distintivo_S_certified_50km.shp")) ## NOTE: we lose a hotel in culiacan if we do 10km, which fits into the 50km buffer.
```

#### Counts by rgn

```{r}
dist_S_counts_by_rgn <- dist_S_goc_rgn %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  distinct(rgn_id, nombre_comercial_clean, year_documented) %>% 
  group_by(rgn_id, year_documented) %>% 
  summarise(n_hotels = n(), .groups = "drop")
```


#### plotly over time

```{r}
dist_S_counts_by_rgn <- dist_S_counts_by_rgn %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year_documented))

library(plotly)

plot_ly(
  dist_S_counts_by_rgn,
  x = ~year,
  y = ~n_hotels,
  color = ~factor(rgn_id),
  type = 'scatter',
  mode = 'lines+markers'
) %>% 
  layout(
    title = "Distintivo S Certified Hotels by GoC Region (2015–2023)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Certified Hotels"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Region ID"))
  )

```


## Compare with DENUE Accommodations

```{r}
alojamientos_2019_2024_50km <- st_read(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/inegi_denue/d2025/servicios_alojamiento_temporal_y_preparación_alimentos_y_bebidas/int","update_alojamientos_2019_2024_goc_50km.shp"))

library(stringi)

alojamientos_2019_2024_50km_clean <- alojamientos_2019_2024_50km %>% 
  mutate(
    nombre_comercial_clean = nom_estab %>% 
      str_to_lower() %>% 
      str_squish() %>% 
      stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") %>% # remove accents
      str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9 ]", "") %>% # remove punctuation
      str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%  # normalize spaces
      str_replace_all("\\b(hotel|resort|spa|suites|suite|all inclusive|the|grupo)\\b", "") %>% 
      str_squish()
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    employees_estimated = case_when(
      per_ocu == "0 a 5 personas" ~ 3,
      per_ocu == "6 a 10 personas" ~ 8,
      per_ocu == "11 a 30 personas" ~ 20.5,
      per_ocu == "31 a 50 personas" ~ 40.5,
      per_ocu == "51 a 100 personas" ~ 75.5,
      per_ocu == "101 a 250 personas" ~ 175.5,
      per_ocu %in% c("251 y m<e1>s personas", "251 y más personas") ~ 300,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

all_hotels <- unique(alojamientos_2019_2024_50km_clean$nombre_comercial_clean)


```

### Join w DENUE, find avg size of Distintivo S hotels.

```{r}
dist_s_denue_id <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/sust_int","DistintivoS_x_DENUE_Accommodations.csv")) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(id_denue)) %>%  # if it did not have a denue id, it is either not a hotel or it did not have enough information to know which hotel it was. This was done through manual searches *after* using setdiff first.
  select(hotel_resort_name, id_denue)

join_denue_alojamientos_dist_s <- left_join(dist_s_denue_id, alojamientos_2019_2024_50km_clean, by = c("id_denue" = "id"))

length(unique(join_denue_alojamientos_dist_s$id_denue)) # 31, less than 35 because some had slightly different names but the same DENUE id.
```

Find the avg size of the hotels that have already been able to obtain dist. S, as a standard for the size of hotel that could potentially obtain the certification:

```{r}
# across all regions:
size_join_denue_alojamientos_dist_s <- join_denue_alojamientos_dist_s %>% 
  summarize(avg_employees_dist_s = mean(employees_estimated),
            sd = sd(employees_estimated))

```

For now, filter out to only all the hotels that are that size or larger. 

```{r}
large_hotels_denue <- alojamientos_2019_2024_50km_clean %>% 
  filter(employees_estimated >= 226.1447) %>% 
  group_by(rgn_id, data_year) %>% 
  summarize(total_large_hotels = n()) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  bind_rows(large_hotels_2015_2017)
```

Now, summarize the number of hotels per rgn with dist. S: 

```{r}
sum_dist_S_goc_50km <- dist_S_goc_50km %>% 
  group_by(rgn_id, yr_dcmn) %>% 
  summarize(total_dist_s = n()) %>% 
  mutate(data_year = as.numeric(yr_dcmn)) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

joined_distS_vs_large_hotels <- full_join(sum_dist_S_goc_50km, large_hotels_denue, by = c("rgn_id","data_year"))

## regions that have large hotels but no distintivo S:
joined_distS_vs_large_hotels_fix <- joined_distS_vs_large_hotels %>% 
  mutate(total_dist_s = ifelse(is.na(total_dist_s) & data_year %in% c(2015, 2017, 2023), 0, total_dist_s)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(total_dist_s))
```

## Current Status

```{r}

  mutate(current_status = (total_dist_s / total_large_hotels) * 100) %>%

  ungroup()

missing_regions <- expand.grid(

avg_2023_dist2 <- dist_S_cs_final %>%
```

### Gapfill

```{r}
library(zoo)

dist_S_current_status_complete <- dist_S_current_status_final %>% 
  complete(rgn_id, data_year = 2015:2024) %>% 
  mutate(current_status = as.numeric(current_status))  


dist_S_current_status_gapfilled_interpolated <- dist_S_current_status_complete %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, data_year) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    score_interpolated = na.approx(
      current_status,
      x = data_year,
      rule = 2,
      na.rm = FALSE
    ),
    is_gapfilled = ifelse(is.na(current_status), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(dist_S_current_status_gapfilled_interpolated, here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/output_sustainability","dist_S_current_status_final_interpolated_121625.csv"))
```

Read in the fees over time for protected areas.  

This data is directly from CONANP: it was tabulated using tabula.  The original pdfs are located at `~/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/CONANP/d2025`.  See this issue comment for more details: <https://github.com/OHI-GOC/OHI_GOC_issues/issues/13#issuecomment-3598113291>


```{r}
raw_ingresos_conanp <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/CONANP/d2025/tabula","tabula-RECAUDACION_INAI 340008300023725 2012-2024.csv"))

clean_ingresos_conanp <- raw_ingresos_conanp %>% 
  fill(region_area_natural_protegida, .direction = "down") %>% # come back to this and check that it makes sense.
  mutate(ent_fed_clean = case_when(
     ent_fed == "B C" ~ "baja_california",
     ent_fed == "B C S"~ "baja_california_sur", 
     ent_fed == "BC Y BCS" ~ "mix_baja", # all are pacific side <https://descubreanp.conanp.gob.mx/en/conanp/ANP?suri=77>
     ent_fed == "SON" ~ "sonora",
     ent_fed %in% c("SIN", "SIN.") ~ "sinaloa",  
     ent_fed == "NAY." ~ "nayarit",
     ent_fed == "MICH." ~ "michoacan",
     ent_fed == "JAL." ~ "jalisco",
     ent_fed == "JAL/COL"~"jalisco_colima", # too deep inland <https://descubreanp.conanp.gob.mx/es/conanp/ANP?suri=174>
     ent_fed == "ZAC."~ "zacatecas",
     ent_fed == "MEX/MICH" ~ "mex_michoacan",
     ent_fed == "COL." ~ "colima",
     TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>% 
  mutate(region_area_natural_protegida = stringr::str_to_lower(region_area_natural_protegida),
         region_area_natural_protegida_clean = stringr::str_replace_all(region_area_natural_protegida, " ", "_"),
         region_area_natural_protegida_clean = stringr::str_replace_all(region_area_natural_protegida, "\\.", "")) %>% 
  select(region_area_natural_protegida_clean, ent_fed_clean, articulo, ingresos_2012:total)
```

### Assign OHI Regions

Because some polygons for the protected areas span multiple regions, at first I thought I needed to figure out a proportion of fees to each area.  But each area is managed by a specific state, which fits into the OHI GoC regions.  

But, according to the legal provision governing fees (e.g. “Artículo 198” for marine/coastal protected areas, and “Artículo 198 A” for terrestrial ones): the income from those fees “se destinarán a la Comisión Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas, para la conservación y aprovechamiento sustentable de las Áreas Naturales Protegidas.” <https://www.conanp.gob.mx/acciones/articulo_198.php>

And, some studies have shown that very little actually goes back into the management of the protected areas, but instead more to the admin of the Secretaria de Hacienda y Credito Publico (SHCP).  <https://nossamexico.com/cuidar-lo-que-importa-las-areas-naturales-protegidas-y-el-cobro-de-derechos-un-analisis-desde-el-noroeste-de-mexico/>

Regardless, we can still assume that the fees are collected at the state level and sent to the federal CONANP agency.  This still in some ways impacts the ability for the protected areas to be managed.  So, I will do a case_when() based on the state to assign regions.


```{r}
## assign ohi goc regions based on the state handling fee collections.
ohi_rgn_ingresos_conanp <- pivot_longer_ingresos_conanp %>% 
  mutate(rgn_id = case_when(
    ent_fed_clean == "baja_california" ~ "Region_2", # not Region_1 because if you look at the `anpmx_all_goc` we see that none of the protected areas in that area are actually managed, or have the federal entity, of Baja California.  Even the islas del golfo are managed by Guaymas.
    ent_fed_clean == "baja_california_sur" ~ "Region_4", # before el vizcaino because that is the only one in Region 3.
    region_area_natural_protegida_clean %in% c("nopolo") ~ "Region_4",
    region_area_natural_protegida_clean %in% c("el vizcaino") ~ "Region_3",
    region_area_natural_protegida_clean %in% c("alto golfo de california y delta del rio colorado", "el pinacate y gran desierto de altar") ~ "Region_5",
    region_area_natural_protegida_clean %in% c("isla de san pedro martir") ~ "Region_6",
    region_area_natural_protegida_clean %in% c("islas del golfo de california, guaymas") ~ "Region_7",
    ent_fed_clean == "sinaloa" ~ "Region_8",
    region_area_natural_protegida_clean %in% c("islas del golfo de california, zona sur, sinaloa","playa ceuta") ~ "Region_8",
    ent_fed_clean == "nayarit" ~ "Region_9",
    region_area_natural_protegida_clean %in% c("cuenca alimentadora del distrito nacional de riego 043 estado de", "isla isabel","islas marias","islas marietas") ~ "Region_9",
  )) %>% 
  filter(region_area_natural_protegida_clean != "sierra de alamos rio cuchujaqui")

## i personally think that sierra de alamos rio cuchujaqui is too far inland, but I know we have other things that far inland.... we can reassess later, but right now I am DROPPING it because it just looks much too removed from the Gulf (representative species etc) <https://descubreanp.conanp.gob.mx/es/conanp/ANP?suri=150>
```

## Sum by GoC Rgn

```{r}
sum_ingresos_conanp_goc <- ohi_rgn_ingresos_conanp %>% 
  group_by(year, rgn_id) %>% 
  summarize(annual_collection_pesos = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE))

```

Now, let's make the current status:

For each year, it will be the amount of fees collected divided by the average amount from years 2012 to 2022, as a way to determine if it has been stable.

(current year of fees collected) / (avg fees collected for that region from 2012 - 2022) * 100

Where it should be equal or more than that historical average to get a score of 100.

```{r}
## calc reference (historical) average per region, 2012-2022
ref_avg_ingresos <- sum_ingresos_conanp_goc %>% 
  filter(year >= 2012, year <= 2022) %>% 
  group_by(rgn_id) %>% 
  summarize(ref_avg_pesos = mean(annual_collection_pesos, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup()

## join to full dataset
status_ingresos <- sum_ingresos_conanp_goc %>% 
  left_join(ref_avg_ingresos, by = "rgn_id") %>% 
  mutate(
    current_status_raw = (annual_collection_pesos / ref_avg_pesos) * 100,
    current_status = as.numeric(pmin(current_status_raw, 100)), # cap at 100
    year = as.numeric(year)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(rgn_id, year)

write_csv(status_ingresos, here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/sust_int/conanp_int","status_ingresos_120825.csv"))

```

Plotly of current status over time:

```{r}
library(plotly)

plot_ly(
  data = status_ingresos,
  x = ~year,
  y = ~current_status,
  split = ~rgn_id,
  color = ~rgn_id,
  type = "scatter", 
  mode = "lines"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "CONANP fee collection status over time (relative to average fees from 2012-2022)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Status (0 to 100)", range = c(0, 110)),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "OHI GoC Region"))
  ) %>% 
  add_lines(
    x = range(status_ingresos$year), 
    y = c(100, 100),
    line = list(color = "black", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Meta // Goal (100/100)",
    inherit = FALSE
  )

plot_ly(
  data = status_ingresos,
  x = ~year,
  y = ~current_status_raw,
  split = ~rgn_id,
  color = ~rgn_id,
  type = "scatter", 
  mode = "lines"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "CONANP fee collection status over time (relative to average fees from 2012-2022)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Status (0 to 100)", range = c(0, 1062.01)),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "OHI GoC Region"))
  ) %>% 
  add_lines(
    x = range(status_ingresos$year), 
    y = c(100, 100),
    line = list(color = "black", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Meta // Goal (100/100)",
    inherit = FALSE
  )

```
